subject: general
question: Indore gharana is one of the vocal gharanas of Indian classical music. It was founded by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Amir Khan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Indore Gharana is one of the vocal Gharanas of Indian classical music which was founded by Amir Khan.
 
• The performance of the Indore Gharana is noted by the vilambit tempo in the style of Abdul Wahid Khan, and the taans reminiscent of Rajab Ali Khan.
 
• Some of the noted vocalists and disciples of Amir Khan are Pandith Amarnath, Shankar Lal Mishra, Kankana Banerjee, Purvi Mukherjee, etc.
 
• The famous musician Sultan Khan (Sarangi player) developed his music under Indore Gharana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Doreswamy V. Iyengar was a renowned violinist and composer from South India, known for his contributions to Carnatic music. He is not associated with the Indore Gharana.
 
• Dr. Lakshminarayana Subramaniam is a renowned violinist and composer from South India, known for his contributions to Indian classical music. He is not associated with the Indore Gharana.
 
• Ustad Bundu Khan was a renowned sarangi player from the Punjab Gharana. He is not associated with the Indore Gharana.
